reasoningSummary: Let Q(x) and S(x) be the quotient and remainder when f(x) is divided by (x+1)(x-1). Since Q(x)=S(x) and deg S<2, write S(x)=R(x)=ax+b. Then f(x)=(x^2-1)R(x)+R(x)=x^2R(x). The remainder upon division by x-1 is f(1)=R(1)=1. Given R(0)=2, b=2, so a+2=1 and a=-1. All five choices were checked: only choice index 1 (-1) matches; indices 0, 2, 3, and 4 are wrong.
